crossRefs.note: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has…
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
“Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they…
Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your…
for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”
Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because…
Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of…
The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been…
The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for…
God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain…

translations.web: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
translations.bsb: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
translations.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
translations.asv: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
